coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Rock Channel Lane

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE (planned, unbuilt) on the undivided remainder lot 8719A006; edges are Blocks J's and I's traced edges (~1-3 m) and the TAFB property line / unbuilt Bridgeview Street line.
notes.digitized_from: Mission Rock Design Controls, Figure 6.2 (p.151), Figure 3.1.1 - Location Map of Open Spaces (p.45) and Section 3.4 Channel Lane (p.66).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor lot exists under this open space -- 8719A006, the undivided remainder of Seawall Lot 337 recorded 2020-06-12 -- but it has not been subdivided per block, so joining status.csv to it would paint the same ~9-acre parking-lot shape for every unbuilt block. Hand-derived geometry is used instead, with the lot's own lines wherever this open space touches them.
notes.regulatory_context: Dedicated open space, Design Controls Section 3.4: a 50 ft maximum plaza with a 12 ft pedestrian throughway, not accessible by vehicles, a protected view corridor from Mission Rock Square to the Bay, connecting across Terry A Francois Boulevard to Channel Wharf.

milestones.text: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls (Resolution 18-04), which name this planned open space as Channel Lane (Design Controls Section 3.4)
